name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_accessory_respiratory_muscles_used_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently demonstrates use of accessory respiratory muscles.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently demonstrates use of accessory respiratory muscles.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not demonstrate use of accessory respiratory muscles.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently demonstrates use of accessory respiratory muscles.

name: patient_has_finding_of_accessory_respiratory_muscles_used_now@@identified_on_physical_exam
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's use of accessory respiratory muscles is identified on physical examination.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's use of accessory respiratory muscles is specifically identified on physical examination.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's use of accessory respiratory muscles is not identified on physical examination.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's use of accessory respiratory muscles is identified on physical examination.

name: patient_has_finding_of_increased_respiratory_rate_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has increased respiratory rate.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a respiratory rate that is considered increased by clinical standards.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have an increased respiratory rate.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has increased respiratory rate.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_chronic_obstructive_pulmonary_disease_now@@moderate_exacerbation
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is in moderate exacerbation.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and the disease is in moderate exacerbation.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease but the disease is not in moderate exacerbation.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is in moderate exacerbation.

name: patient_hydrogen_ion_concentration_value_recorded_now_withunit_ph
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's arterial blood pH measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no arterial blood pH measurement is available for now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's arterial blood pH is recorded now.

name: patient_carbon_dioxide_value_recorded_now_withunit_mm_hg
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure measured now, in mm Hg.
when_unknown: Set to null if no arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure measurement is available for now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure (PaCO2) is recorded now in mm Hg.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_finding_of_sleep_apnea_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has sleep apnea syndrome.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical finding or diagnosis of sleep apnea syndrome.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical finding or diagnosis of sleep apnea syndrome.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical finding or diagnosis of sleep apnea syndrome.

name: patient_is_receiving_noninvasive_ventilation_at_home_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently being treated with noninvasive ventilation at home.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with noninvasive ventilation at home.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently being treated with noninvasive ventilation at home.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently being treated with noninvasive ventilation at home.

name: patient_is_affiliated_to_french_social_security_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently affiliated to French social security.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently affiliated to French social security.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not affiliated to French social security.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently affiliated to French social security.

name: patient_has_contraindication_to_high_flow_nasal_oxygen_therapy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a contraindication to high-flow nasal oxygen therapy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a contraindication to high-flow nasal oxygen therapy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a contraindication to high-flow nasal oxygen therapy.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a contraindication to high-flow nasal oxygen therapy.

name: patient_has_contraindication_to_noninvasive_ventilation_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a contraindication to noninvasive ventilation.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a contraindication to noninvasive ventilation.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a contraindication to noninvasive ventilation.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a contraindication to noninvasive ventilation.

name: patient_was_previously_included_in_study
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient was previously included in the study at any time prior to the current screening.
when_true: Set to true if the patient was previously included in the study at any time prior to the current screening.
when_false: Set to false if the patient was not previously included in the study at any time prior to the current screening.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient was previously included in the study.
